rows.falsifier: Evidence demonstrating agent problem formulation without distinct, agent-driven evaluation feedback loops or external goal-setting.
rows.reason: Updated with recent active inference and interactive problem-formulation evidence supporting the link between internal evaluation signals and autonomous problem selection.
rows.statement: Computational creativity frameworks require robust integration between formulation and evaluation components, supported by active inference and drift-diffusion mechanisms, for agents to autonomously navigate and identify novel, worthwhile problems.
